## 4. Frozen cases, expected outcomes (predictions stated before the frozen runs) and decision rules
Common instrument: for each end-to-end case the "complementary binding diff" is computed as the set of dotted leaf paths differing between the PERSISTED decision binding (read from the store file) and the binding that the LIVE world genuinely mints for the same proposal (a `decide` in a fresh scratch store using the same live fixtures and clock). It is split into base diff (everything outside `runtime_authority.effective_configuration`) and ECB diff (inside it).
Claim rule (CA04): the end-to-end claim is "isolated end-to-end" ONLY IF base diff == [] AND ECB diff == { effective_configuration.digest, effective_configuration.members.<m> } exactly; otherwise "joint" with the diff recorded. Component evidence never upgrades to end-to-end. The candidate's `configuration_binding_status` is evidence only, never the oracle. The oracle for member content is the harness's own recomputation (`own_commit`: sha256 over canonical JSON; `H.my_digest`).

World constructions. F5 world: Registry F5 class-age selection (r08-v2) for class synthetic-irreversible with value R (default 10); host profile with one irreversible class, `max_status_age_seconds = t1` (default 60), no freshness, no policy_binding; GovernedClassAgeWorkflow; approvals bound to the EFFECTIVE profile (supported host duty). Domain world: F4 GovernedAgeWorkflow whose host manifest action authority_context.authority_domain = d, with a self-consistent proposal (manifest_digest), resolver (every domain field), and Registry selection re-signed for d. d1 = customer-refunds, d2 = other-domain.

## 5. Claim vocabulary and the A25 acceptance criterion
Evidence layers per member: C = component, P = protected comparison behavior (persisted-side reseal, reused from the original A19 rows, NOT rerun), R = reachability/guard order (static file:line plus observed first-guard), E = end-to-end refusal.
Vocabulary: "isolated end-to-end" (rule above); "isolated end-to-end by GRAFT" (rule above, store-level construction, label mandatory); "joint" (diff recorded); "guard-first" (a different guard refused before the ECB was consulted); "component only".
Acceptance criterion A25(a)/(e) (member independently exercised so that a perturbation of that member alone changes the digest and causes refusal), decided per member, with decision rules fixed now:
- MET: a natural supported route yields "isolated end-to-end" with every check of its case passing.
- MET ONLY BY GRAFT: no natural route isolates, but the graft case yields "isolated end-to-end by GRAFT" with every check passing and the control/neutral cases passing.
- DECOMPOSED-ONLY: only component and joint/guard-first evidence exist (member sensitivity shown at component or persisted-reseal level, never alone end-to-end on the live side).
- NOT MET: component evidence itself fails, or the end-to-end case contradicts the predicted refusal.
Predicted verdicts: host_profile_digest MET (Q3-H1); scope.authority_domain MET ONLY BY GRAFT (Q2-A3; natural isolation structurally impossible, Q2-A2 joint); effective_profile_digest DECOMPOSED-ONLY (Q3-E1 guard-first, Q3-E2 joint; persisted-side reseal A19 reused).
A prediction that fails is an ADVERSE FINDING recorded as observed; it is never revised here or rescored.

## 8. Amendments, stop conditions, exclusions
- Harness defects: dated append-only amendments under amendments/ (pre-amendment copy, diff, reason); first-run raw outputs are never overwritten; expectations are never edited.
- Implementation defect observed: preserve the counterexample verbatim and stop that case; do not repair or qualify a repair.
- Not run (explicit): disabling manifest_digest/authority_domain/approval guards; subclass/patch routes for derivation; effective_profile_digest freshness-extension construction (heavy, still joint); pin-export/claim variants; A19 persisted-reseal rows (reused by citation only, not rerun, not re-verified here); any paid/production execution.
- Baselines preserved and not relabelled: original F3-A FAIL (23 assertions), readjudication 1-failed G4 result, M06 original SURVIVED record, original A25(a)/(e) UNREACHABLE-ISOLATED records. Disagreement with them, if any, is reported as a new finding, not a correction.
